title: Flying Food Group Wins 2024 Instawork Economic Opportunity Award
summary: Learn why Flying Food Group, DC was named a recipient of Instawork's 2024 Best Places for Flexible Work Awards.
body_markdown:
Our team at Instawork is proud to announce that the[Flying Food Group](https://flyingfood.com/) in the Washington D.C. area has been awarded the prestigious 2024 Instawork Economic Opportunity Award for their outstanding commitment to providing consistent and meaningful work opportunities for hourly workers. This accolade highlights their dedication to creating a supportive and adaptable work environment that benefits both their workforce and operations.


### Why Consistency Matters


Providing regular work opportunities is crucial for hourly workers who rely on steady income to manage their lives effectively. Flying Food Group DC understands that consistency is not just a business strategy; it's a commitment to their workers' well-being and professional growth. Here's why consistency is key:


#### **Financial stability**


Reliable income is paramount for financial stability. Regular work opportunities ensure that hourly workers have a dependable income, allowing them to budget effectively, pay bills on time, and plan for future expenses without the stress of uncertain work hours. This financial stability reduces stress, enabling workers to focus on their jobs and personal lives with confidence.


#### **Job satisfaction and professional growth**


Regular work opportunities allow staff to achieve a better work-life balance. Knowing their work schedule in advance lets them plan personal activities, family time, and other commitments without conflict. Consistent work also helps employees build their skills and gain valuable experience, which is essential for career advancement and personal development.
